analysis_refs.heading: The ten candidates
analysis_refs.text:
This is ten discovery options, not ten demonstrated net-new origins in production.
GDL and BHL aggregate contributors; do not add their contributor counts on top.
BHL's Internet Archive hosting is not another source. Measure item/publisher
overlap with existing StoryWeaver, Book Dash, OTL and Gutenberg before reporting
incremental coverage. The five named publishers have distinct publisher IDs;
their chapters, editions and mirrored files do not increase that count.

analysis_refs.heading: Query behavior and operating constraints
analysis_refs.text:
All six retrieval families—GDL, MediaWiki, LoC JSON, Internet Archive search,
LibriVox and Thoth—were probed with a nonsense term. Empty results were observed;
LibriVox expresses this as HTTP 404 with an audiobook-not-found JSON message.
An adapter must distinguish that documented response shape from an outage.
Representative second-page requests were also checked; retain each provider's
paging and scope. These checks are evidence, not implemented app behavior.

analysis_refs.heading: Query behavior and operating constraints
analysis_refs.text:
No paid fallback is proposed. All tested search requests worked anonymously.
Respect current provider limits and use bounded requests, cancellation, backoff
and truthful unavailable states. No numeric unlimited allowance is inferred where
documentation does not publish one. Wikimedia calls should be serial with a
descriptive User-Agent and maxlag for research; Internet Archive also requests
identification of automated clients. LibriVox documents a maximum page size of
500 and pacing for bulk work. We requested only three catalog records at a time,
except GDL's fixed 20-record search page.

analysis_refs.text:

analysis_refs.heading: C20 — Educational podcasts, lectures and documentaries
analysis_refs.text:
**Where to start.** Begin with universities, public educational broadcasters and
institutional media producers, following their series/catalog links. In India,
[NPTEL's course catalog](https://nptel.ac.in/courses) provides instructor/course
and institutional discovery leads; investigate official educational broadcaster
and university series alongside it. For international and US material, inspect
university lecture catalogs and public-media learning collections. The
[Internet Archive developer portal](https://archive.org/developers/) documents
metadata tools for archive-hosted media; [Wikimedia Commons API guidance](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Commons:API)
supports another metadata route, with license and exclusion markers to review.

analysis_refs.heading: Evidence limits and research handoff
analysis_refs.text:
This pass reviewed official documentation and directory pages on 2026-11-05.
NARA, Archives Portal Europe, National Archives of India, Museums of India,
Bharatavani, Europeana, PRGI, INN/Find Your News, loc.gov, NPTEL, Internet Archive,
Commons and WordPress pages were retrievable. OLAC FAQ and LINCS direct opens
returned 403 despite official search-index descriptions; treat those details as
leads pending direct recheck. Smithsonian `openaccess/devtools` and
`openaccess/faq` opens returned 404 despite indexed results; locate their current
official documentation before qualification. These observations do not establish
service-wide failure or full-item availability.

analysis_refs.heading: What the original checks established
analysis_refs.text: Structured responses were obtained from Google Books (using the configured key), Open Library, Internet Archive, DOAJ, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Europe PMC, CORE, Zenodo, HAL, Wikisource, Library of Congress, and LibriVox. Gutenberg RDF and DOAB record/harvesting responses also worked. OAPEN's OAI service identification worked; a record import was not exercised.

analysis_refs.heading: What the original checks established
analysis_refs.text:
- An Open Library work returned `ebook_access: public` alongside many Internet Archive identifiers. That does not identify which edition is freely readable.
- A HAL hit had a record URL and DOI but no `fileMain_s`: a repository hit is not necessarily full text.
- Zenodo returned a dataset; item-type filtering is essential.
- DOAJ supplied an older HTTP publisher URL; metadata alone does not prove the destination still works.
- Semantic Scholar returned **429**, and Gutendex timed out. Those checks do not establish general service availability.
- Some documentation URLs moved; corrected DOAB/OAPEN URLs appear in the catalog. Some sites returned only a JavaScript shell. NCERT/ERIC/OER Commons could not be fully inspected.
